answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the fable of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on invitation quota tree, converted to a slow vesting stream. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The kernel is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the walnut.
